dogecoin.text: If you use @bittylicious to directly trade from £GBP into #cryptocurrencies, and track your portfolio in @get_delta, plz go here to to vote to get it added to Delta: https://t.co/0XBSplbkvJ $DGB $BTC $LTC $ETH $DASH $DOGE $STRAT $BCH $FTC $GRS $GBP $MUE $PPC $SYS $VTC #crypto

I’ve never taken #DOGE seriously, because it was never meant to be taken seriously. 

Elon has stressed that his $DOGE tweets are just for fun. He doesn’t take it srsly either.

Remember: #Doge is inflationary - its supply is unlimited. Supply & demand ppl. The fun won’t last.

This is about the most cynical take you could have about the #crypto industry, but if I’d created #Dogecoin as a joke, and then seen it grow to become the very worst example of that which it was originally designed to parody, I’d be pretty cynical too…
